properties.name: spring.data.couchbase.auto-index
properties.description: Automatically create views and indexes. Use the meta-data provided by "@ViewIndexed", "@N1qlPrimaryIndexed" and "@N1qlSecondaryIndexed".

properties.name: spring.data.couchbase.bucket-name
properties.description: Name of the bucket to connect to.

properties.name: spring.data.couchbase.field-naming-strategy
properties.description: Fully qualified name of the FieldNamingStrategy to use.

properties.name: spring.data.couchbase.repositories.type
properties.description: Type of Couchbase repositories to enable.

properties.name: spring.data.couchbase.scope-name
properties.description: Name of the scope used for all collection access.

properties.name: spring.data.couchbase.type-key
properties.description: Name of the field that stores the type information for complex types when using "MappingCouchbaseConverter".
